dose.text: Adult male mice were treated with intraperitoneal injection of phosphate buffered saline (PBS), OT (100 ng/kg of body weight), or LOT-1 (100 ng/kg of body weight), one day (24 h) prior to the behavioral experiments; (B) Time spent in the inside zone measured over 20 min in CD157−/− mice with different treatments.

reported_results.text: One-way ANOVA revealed no significant difference in CD157+/+ mice (n = 4–5, F3,14 = 1.01, P = 0.4188) but a significant difference in CD157−/− mice (n = 4–6, F3,15 = 54.14,
post hoc test indicated significant differences between PBS and OT (P = 0.0000), PBS and LOT-1 (P = 0.005), or OT and LOT-1 (P = 0.018) (n = 5 per group).
